raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Fix fused RoPE indexing when packed (THD) inputs provide one frequency row per token. For CP=1 with matching token and frequency counts, use TE's fused SBHD kernel on a `[T, 1, H, D]` view so frequency rows continue across sequences. Other per-token layouts fall back to the unfused implementation; shared position tables keep the fused THD path.

Port of [NVIDIA-NeMo/nv-mistralai-megatron#744](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/nv-mistralai-megatron/pull/744) onto public `main`. Both original commits are retained separately with unchanged patches, authorship, author dates, subjects, and original commit-message content. Each includes a `cherry picked from commit` reference and is signed and signed off.

| Original commit | Public commit |
| --- | --- |
| [f634a5f28a](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/nv-mistralai-megatron/commit/f634a5f28ab9fcae787a95add9a3c3ca08aaccba) | [2a32fbda34](https://github.com/yashaswikarnati/Megatron-LM/commit/2a32fbda34a79fe457957529b7f0a9bece029b8d) |
| [97f6ec49d3](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/nv-mistralai-megatron/commit/97f6ec49d35c42c3103a75844faaf7a78283af95) | [672c0e2b15](https://github.com/yashaswikarnati/Megatron-LM/commit/672c0e2b158cfc8b6f789e9fa5f144d0393bacdb) |

The SHAs change because the commits are replayed onto public `main`; stable patch IDs match both originals.

### Validation

- Preserved all regression tests from the source PR.
- `git diff --check`, patch-equivalence checks, and SSH signature verification passed.
- `BASE_REF=main CHECK_ONLY=true SKIP_DOCS=false bash tools/autoformat.sh` passed Black, isort, pylint, and Ruff in the existing Megatron container. The script's optional mypy step was unavailable.
- GPU tests were not rerun for this port. Prior GPU validation is documented in the source PR.

- [ ] I, the PR author, have personally reviewed every line of this PR.

 from torch import Tensor
 
 from megatron.core import parallel_state

 logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
 
@@ -389,6 +390,24 @@ def apply_rotary_pos_emb(
                     "Using unfused implementation."
                 )
                 use_unfused = True
+            # Like unfused THD, infer packed-token frequencies from rows > max_seqlen.
+            # These rows continue across sequences; shared position tables restart at row 0.
+            freqs_in_packed_order = max_seqlen is not None and freqs.size(0) > max_seqlen
+            if not use_unfused and freqs_in_packed_order:
+                if cp_group.size() == 1 and freqs.size(0) == t.size(0):
+                    # Frequencies already align with local tokens. RoPE is token-wise,
+                    # so the SBHD kernel can treat them as one sequence with batch size 1.
+                    assert (
+                        fused_apply_rotary_pos_emb is not None
+                    ), "apply_rope_fusion is not available."
+                    return fused_apply_rotary_pos_emb(
+                        t.unsqueeze(1), freqs, interleaved=config.rotary_interleaved
+                    ).squeeze(1)
+                warn_single_rank(
+                    "apply_rope_fusion supports per-token RoPE frequencies only with one row per "
+                    "token and no context parallelism. Using unfused implementation."
+                )
+                use_unfused = True
             if not use_unfused:

                     fused_apply_rotary_pos_emb_thd is not None
